source: KNOWN_GAP: enum constants used as receivers are left untyped
notes: call_type convention (SPEC names the six call_types but does not define direct vs method): a call with no written receiver is direct; a call with a written receiver (obj., this., super., a type name) is method; new/super(...)/this(...) are constructor. `Level.HIGH` and `Level.LOW` have type Level (decision A: 'An enum constant `E.C` has type `E`'), so `.weight()` on them is Level#weight, high, not `HIGH.weight` low. Inside the enum the constant is written bare (`HIGH.weight()`); it is the same constant Level.HIGH, type Level. Two calls on Alert.java:5 give two identical edges (multiset).
